messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
On 15 July 2023, did Chapter VI of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 already apply, instead of Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC, to products placed on the market in conformity with the Directive?

response.text: As of 15 July 2023, was Chapter VI of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 already in force in place of Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC for products that had been placed on the market in conformity with the Directive?
